**Free!**

**Free!**

**Free!**

**3:00 p.m.** –**5:00 p.m.**

**Free!**

### [Climate Future Film Festival hosted by Growing Good Community Garden](https://www.nycgovparks.org/events/2026/10/18/climate-future-film-festival-hosted-by-growing-good-communit)

**Free!**
## Monday, October 19, 2026
Oct19
### [Soil Health Field Day with Cornell Cooperative Extension](https://www.nycgovparks.org/events/2026/10/19/soil-health-field-day-with-cornell-cooperative-extension)
#### at Governors Island, Manhattan
**11:30 a.m.** –**3:30 p.m.**  
A hands-on look at soil health for urban growers with Cornell Cooperative Extension’s urban ag team and other NYC soil folks. Food & farmer chats begin at 11:30am, demos begin at 1pm.   
**Free!**
